about.title: About Karshi International University
about.p1: Karshi International University (KIU) was founded in 2022 in the city of Karshi, Kashkadarya region. It is one of the modern centers of higher education in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
about.p2: Our goal is to prepare students for life by giving them quality education and soft skills, and to create opportunities for education, research and professional development to international standards.

items.a: Admission runs every year from July 1 to August 20. Documents can be submitted to the admissions committee in person or online.
Passport or birth certificate, school-leaving certificate, two 3x4 photos, and a medical certificate (form 086).

items.q: Can I study on a grant?
items.a: Yes! KIU offers rector's and founders' scholarships. Applicants with high scores can study on a grant.
Yes, the university has a modern dormitory for students. Places are limited, so we recommend applying early.

items.q: Which programs are the most in demand?
items.a: Software Engineering, Economics and Psychology are the most in-demand programs.

items.q: How much is the tuition fee?
items.a: The fee depends on the program. For details, contact the admissions committee: +998 55 500 99 44.

items.q: Is there cooperation with foreign universities?
items.a: Yes! KIU cooperates with universities in Malaysia, Russia, Latvia, Poland, Italy and India. The full list is on the International cooperation page.

items.q: Is there a free bus service?
items.a: Yes, the university runs a free bus service for students. Contact us for information about routes and the schedule.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: The history and mission of Karshi International University
about.p1: Karshi International University (KIU) was founded in 2022 in the city of Karshi, Kashkadarya region. It is one of the leading higher education centers in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
about.p2: Our goal is to give students quality education and soft skills, preparing them for life, not just for exams. Most importantly, we wish for others the best that we wish for ourselves!
about.p3: Through modern teaching methods, a team of professional teachers and international partnerships, the university prepares students for the professions of the future.
about.missionText: Not limiting ourselves to giving students knowledge alone, but equipping them with the skills they need and preparing them for life. Creating opportunities for education, research and professional development to international standards.

testimonials.title: Student reviews
testimonials.subtitle: What our students say about KIU

1.text: Studying at KIU changed my life. Thanks to modern teaching methods and professional teachers, I have learned a great deal.

2.text: The international cooperation programs and scholarship opportunities are excellent. I got the chance to study at foreign universities.

3.text: The teachers are always ready to help. The campus atmosphere is very warm and friendly. I am happy I chose KIU!

4.text: The free bus, the dormitory and the modern library — all of these have made studying comfortable.

5.text: The opportunity to take part in international conferences is wonderful. This experience matters a lot for my future plans.

6.text: Thanks to the knowledge I gained at KIU, I was able to find a good job. I am proud of our university!

1.q: What do you like to do in your free time?

opts.a: I enjoy programming or working on technical projects
opts.b: I play with children and teach them something
opts.c: I read books and learn foreign languages
opts.d: I do calculations and make financial plans

2.q: Which subject interests you the most?

opts.a: Mathematics and physics — I like exact answers
opts.b: Psychology and philosophy — human thinking fascinates me
opts.c: Literature and languages — the power of words and expression
opts.d: Chemistry and biology — the secrets of nature

3.q: How do you act when a problem comes up?

opts.a: I analyze it logically and solve it step by step
opts.b: I talk it through with people and solve it together
opts.c: A creative approach — I look for unconventional solutions
opts.d: I act based on rules and laws

4.q: What kind of work do you want to do in the future?

opts.a: Creating software and apps in the world of technology
opts.b: Raising the younger generation and working in education
opts.c: Managing money in banking, finance or business

5.q: What role do you play in a team?

opts.a: Leader — I make decisions and give direction
opts.b: Analyst — I study the data and make recommendations
opts.c: Communicator — I resolve problems through negotiation
opts.d: Creative — I come up with new ideas

6.q: Which work environment do you like more?

opts.a: Office and computer — a quiet, analytical setting
opts.b: Classroom — working with children and young people
opts.c: Lots of people — communication, seminars, trainings
opts.d: Field and hands-on work — with equipment and machinery

opts.b: A young child coming to understand something
opts.c: Justice being served and the law protecting people

8.q: How do you feel about learning foreign languages?

opts.a: I love it — languages excite me
opts.b: I need it for work — knowing English is enough
opts.c: I'll learn, but my main specialty matters more
opts.d: Interesting, but exact sciences are closer to me

9.q: Which school subject Olympiad would you have entered?

opts.a: Mathematics or physics — exact sciences interest me
opts.b: Biology or chemistry — I love the secrets of nature and substances
opts.c: Native language or literature — the power of words and expression
opts.d: History or law — society and laws are interesting to me

10.q: When your friends run into trouble, what do they ask you for?

opts.a: Technical help — with computers, software or the internet
opts.b: Financial advice — about money, debt or investment
opts.d: Legal advice — on law and documents

11.q: Which position appeals to you the most?

opts.a: Developer or IT manager — at a technology company
opts.c: Financial analyst or auditor — at a bank or company
opts.d: Lawyer or attorney — a defender of law and justice

12.q: What videos or content do you like to watch in your free time?

opts.a: About technology, programming and artificial intelligence
opts.b: Fun experiments and educational videos with kids
opts.d: About oil, geology, industry and energy

13.q: Which skill do you think is your strongest?

opts.a: Logical thinking and solving problems systematically
opts.b: Language and communication — I get along with people easily
opts.c: Numbers and calculations — financial math comes easily to me

14.q: Which sentence best matches your philosophy of life?

opts.a: "Every child is the future, and they must be raised right"
opts.b: "Technology changes the world — and I want to be part of it"
opts.c: "The law is equal for all — we must fight for justice"
opts.d: "Money is a tool — managing it well is an art"
